description_en: Queries the image preparation and deployment phases by using the preparation ID. Regular polling does not create a dump task. Only phase=SUCCEEDED indicates that the deployment of the target version is successful. The health of the previous instance does not indicate the success of the current deployment
description_zh: 通过 preparationId 查询本次镜像准备和部署阶段。普通轮询不创建转存任务；只有 phase=SUCCEEDED 表示本次目标版本部署成功，旧实例健康不代表本次成功
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore get-custom-agent-image-preparation --workspace-id ws-example --preparation-id agent-example:1 --api-version 2026-08-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCustomAgentImagePreparation

parameters.help_zh: Console 镜像准备任务 ID

data.description_en: The preparation query result. Refer to the phase for the asynchronous execution status

error.description_zh: 仅失败返回安全错误，其余为 null

message.description_en: The specific cause of the failure. This may include underlying errors such as image not found, authentication failure, network timeout, or certificate verification error. Passwords, tokens, or authentication headers are not returned. If the underlying system does not provide a cause, a general description is returned
